title: Body parts and five senses
examples: Teacher, what do I use to smell flowers?
Can you show me where my elbow is?
Which sense do I use to know if something is hot?

explain.say: Your body has parts with names. Point to your nose.
You smell with your nose. You can smell flowers and warm toast.
Point to your eyes. You see with your eyes. They see colours and shapes.
Point to your ears. You hear with your ears. They hear music and voices.
You taste with your tongue. You feel with your skin. Your hands feel soft and hard things.
These are your five senses. They are sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch.

faq.q: What do I use to hear sounds like dogs barking?
faq.a: You use your ears to hear sounds, like a dog barking.
asks: What do I use to hear sounds like dogs barking?

faq.q: How do I know if food tastes sweet or sour?
faq.a: You use your tongue to taste food. Your tongue tells you if food is sweet or sour.
asks: How do I know if food tastes sweet or sour?
What do I use for taste?

faq.q: What sense do I use to touch a soft teddy bear?
faq.a: You use your skin to feel things. Your hands feel that a teddy is soft.
asks: What sense do I use to touch a soft teddy bear?

faq.q: Do I use my nose to see the rainbow?
faq.a: No, you use your eyes to see the rainbow. Your nose is for smelling.
asks: Do I use my nose to see the rainbow?

faq.q: What are the five senses again?
faq.a: The five senses are sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch.
asks: What are the five senses again?

facts: We have five main senses to help us explore the world.
Our eyes help us to see colours and light.
Our ears help us to hear loud and soft sounds.
Our nose helps us to smell nice flowers.
Our tongue helps us to taste sweet or salty things.

quiz.say: Look at the red apple. Tap the body part that sees it.
quiz.why: You see with your eyes. Your eyes see the red colour.

wrong.0: Your ears hear sounds, like a clap.
wrong.2: Your nose smells things, like a flower.

quiz.say: Think of a loud drum. Tap the body part that hears it.
quiz.why: You hear with your ears. Your ears hear the drum.

wrong.0: Your nose smells things, like warm soup.
wrong.1: Your tongue tastes food, like a lemon.

quiz.say: Think of a sour lemon. Tap the body part that tastes it.
quiz.why: You taste with your tongue. It tells you the lemon is sour.

wrong.1: Your skin feels things, like a soft teddy.
wrong.2: Your eyes see that the lemon is yellow.
